walkthroughs.body_html:
World Religions: Judaism / Islam / Buddhism / Hinduism — a core area of GCSE Religious Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

World Religions: Judaism / Islam / Buddhism / Hinduism brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with World Religions: Judaism / Islam / Buddhism / Hinduism.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: Karma is when bad things happen to bad people as punishment.
